items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Johnny Harrington and I, a clarinet player, he and his wife went downtown and voted.

ctx.x: Do you find most of them, most of the things you have been interested in, were wrong?

Yes, I found out and discovered that in the end the best thing for me to do is stick with my music. If I believe in a political thing or something like that, I push other people. Believe it or not, I've never voted, but I think I can get more votes than anybody else. If I think there's a good man out there, if I have time to think about it, I usually try to get people to vote for him. Well, I'll tell you what happened in Kansas City.
